study.title: C1: constraint-preserving correction and acceptance testing for multi-joint arm world models
research_questions: RQ1: Does a constraint-preserving (contraction) correction still harm forecast accuracy on multi-joint arms (d = 2, 3, 7)?
RQ2: Does LTT acceptance keep accepted runs harmless in-distribution and under range widening as the number of joints grows?
RQ3: Does cross-joint coupling make the full correction matrix the useful candidate as d grows, and what does it add over per-joint (diagonal) weights?
RQ4: How does the judge-set size needed for acceptance change with d (n = 36, 60, 100)?

seeds.reason: 34 seeds: power 0.8 at alpha 0.05 for M1 (sd 0.162, min effect 0.10) and M3 (sd 0.079, min effect 0.05), sds from the 2-DOF pilot (results_h10s_confirm). Seed values mod 1000 = 11..313 differ from every earlier protocol (101..229, 301..423, 503..661, 511..621, 701..857); the planar arms and the Franka model also use different data generators from the 2-DOF oscillators

stats.correction_reason: Holm over the confirmatory claims M1-M4; M5 and the judge-size curve are descriptive

budget.hardware: Apple M5 Max 128GB (primary, parallel cases) via Claude Code; Linux 1 CPU core for a reduced smoke subset and a cross-platform decision check
budget.tuning_reason: No method is tuned on test data: Z and the retrained model use the same fixed MLP settings (width scaled by d), correction strengths lambda are chosen on C_s1 for every correction method from the same grid

datasets.name: planar_2link
datasets.source: self-implemented planar 2-link arm (Lagrangian rigid-body dynamics), nominal parameters as physics prior; truth adds joint friction (Coulomb + viscous), link-mass error and joint coupling
datasets.split: per run: train 12/36, C_f 12, C_s1 12, C_s2 36 (60/100 post hoc), test 48 episodes; test generated with separate seeds

datasets.name: planar_3link
datasets.source: self-implemented planar 3-link arm, same construction as planar_2link

datasets.name: franka_7dof
datasets.source: MuJoCo 4.0.0 (pip) with franka_emika_panda/panda_nohand.xml from MuJoCo Menagerie, commit 98a70c569c4c1b6da467a20012f766ee1f8dc521 (pinned 2026-11-06); prior = nominal model without joint friction/damping mismatch; truth = model with friction, armature and link-mass error
datasets.license: MuJoCo Apache-2.0; franka_emika_panda LICENSE Apache-2.0 (checked at the pinned commit, 2026-11-06)

methods.name: ltt_correction
methods.source: this work (Algorithm 1 of manuscript-v1, unchanged), candidates {0, alpha I, D_lambda, A_lambda}

methods.name: equal_budget_retrain
methods.source: residual MLP retrained on all non-test episodes with the same settings
methods.why: the alternative a deployer with weight access would use; strongest accuracy competitor in the 2-DOF pilot

methods.name: mean_loss_rule
methods.source: apply the C_s1-best candidate if it lowers the C_s1 loss by 1%
methods.why: simplest validation rule; matched LTT's mean gain in the 2-DOF pilot, so it is the fair test of whether the finite-sample gate adds anything

methods.name: per_step_combination
methods.source: per-step combination weights fitted on C_f (Wang et al., Int. J. Forecast. 2023)
methods.why: forecast-combination baseline that breaks kinematic constraints

methods.name: keep_Z
methods.source: learned world model forecast without correction
methods.why: the incumbent every correction must not worsen

claims.claim: On every multi-joint system, the always-applied contraction correction is worse than keep_Z in at least 10% of runs under range widening
claims.min_effect_reason: one run in ten made worse is operationally unacceptable for a deployed forecaster; the 2-DOF pilot showed 0.49
claims.falsify_if: per system: supported if the one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson LOWER bound of the worse share is at least 0.10; not supported if the one-sided 95% UPPER bound is below 0.10; inconclusive otherwise

claims.claim: Among runs that LTT accepts, the share worse than keep_Z in-distribution stays at or below delta = 0.1 on every system
claims.falsify_if: per system: fewer than 10 accepted runs: inconclusive; not supported if the one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson LOWER bound exceeds 0.10; supported if the one-sided 95% UPPER bound is at most 0.10; inconclusive otherwise

claims.claim: On franka_7dof, LTT gives a median per-run relative gain over keep_Z of at least 5% across all runs (rejected runs count as 0)
claims.min_effect_reason: below 5% a deployer would not pay for 60 observed episodes per acceptance
claims.falsify_if: the lower end of the seed-cluster bootstrap 95% interval is below 0.05: not supported

claims.claim: On franka_7dof, adding the full-matrix candidate raises the median gain over the diagonal-only gate by at least 2 points
claims.min_effect_reason: cross-joint coupling is the reason to fit a d x d matrix (49 parameters at d = 7 against 7 for diagonal); a benefit below 5 points does not justify them, and a 2-point effect would need about 186 seeds (plan_tool check)
claims.falsify_if: Holm-adjusted Wilcoxon p >= 0.05 or the median paired difference is below 0.05: not supported

claims.claim: Descriptive: the share of accepted corrections that are full matrices grows with d (2, 3, 7), and the acceptance rate as a function of judge-set size n = 36, 60, 100
claims.min_effect_reason: a 20-point change between d = 2 and d = 7 would change design advice
claims.falsify_if: descriptive; reported as observed without a verdict

rules: 예산의 80% 초과 시 seed를 줄이지 않고 franka_7dof의 학습 에피소드 설정(12/36) 중 하나를 줄인 뒤 기록
